Office 365 Subscription Expiration Notice

Dear Valued Customer,

This is an urgent notification regarding your Microsoft Office 365 subscription.

Your subscription will expire in 24 hours due to a payment issue. To avoid service interruption, please update your payment information immediately.

Subscription Details:
- Plan: Office 365 Business Premium
- Expiration Date: November 10, 2025
- Amount Due: $29.99/month
- Invoice Number: INV-2025-1109

Action Required:
1. Download the attached invoice document
2. Review your billing information
3. Click the link in the invoice to update payment details

If you do not take action within 24 hours:
- Your access to Office 365 applications will be suspended
- All stored documents and emails will be iaccessible
- You will lose access to OneDrive storage

Please download the attached invoice and follow the instructions.

Thank you for choosing Microsoft.

Sincerely,
